title: Highlights from CAE at the 2022 Farnborough Airshow
body_markdown: It’s a wrap for #Farnborough2022. Our Civil Aviation and Defense and Security team put CAE’s cutting-edge training and critical operations solutions on full display. Check out the highlights and announcements from CAE’s time at Farnborough 2022 at[https://www.cae.com/farnborough-airshow-2022/](https://www.cae.com/farnborough-airshow-2022/)
